summary: Iteration 15 — backend & frontend verified for the simplified Landing, Stokvel Intro page, African Country->Province->City cascading regions, and banking-on-signup. 8/8 backend pytest cases pass. 100% of required frontend testids render on /, /stokvels (intro), /stokvels/intro, /auth step 2, /messages, /dashboard. Toast-on-missing-banking not directly executed in browser (re-entering AuthPage step 2 from a partially-completed signup is not preserved across reloads) but the AuthPage source contains the toast string and the form structure is correct (all 7 step-2 testids and POPIA nudge verified live).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~4128 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. The auth/profile, hubs/regions, banking, leaderboard, premium, stokvel, etc. domains should be split into routers. AFRICAN_REGIONS dict (~115 lines) is fine inline but a separate /app/backend/data/regions.py would be cleaner.
GET /api/users/me/banking masks correctly (account_masked uses bullets + last4, full account_number is omitted). Verified by backend test test_complete_profile_with_banking_persists_uppercased_swift.
complete-profile validates country and province cascade (returns 400 with explicit messages) — good. Consider also validating city when province is set (currently city is accepted free-form).

BankingDetailsRequest fields are all required strings but no length/format validation (e.g. SWIFT 8/11 chars, account_number digits-only). For a coordination platform that's acceptable, but a Pydantic regex or @validator would harden it.

StokvelIntroPage correctly uses localStorage 'nc_stokvel_intro_seen' and StokvelEntryRoute gates first visit. The /stokvels/intro route remains always-on so the 'How it works' link works regardless. Good.

LandingPage trimmed to ~95 lines, removed network-score-section/leaderboard-section/transparency-section/live-activity-feed as intended. Compliance language preserved on /stokvels/intro (POPIA, 'not a financial services provider', 'do not promise returns', 'we do not take any of the contributions').

LocationPicker on AuthPage step 2 successfully cascades — country select shows all 13 entries; selecting South Africa populates 9 Gauteng+other provinces; selecting Gauteng populates 5 cities. data-testids signup-location-country / -province / -city present.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% — all required testids and copy verified across LandingPage, StokvelIntroPage, StokvelListPage, AuthPage step 2, /messages, /dashboard. Toast 'Please complete your banking details to participate in groups' not directly fired in a browser run, but the toast string is present in AuthPage.js and gating logic is implemented client-side.

test_credentials: Dynamic users created via POST /api/auth/progressive-signup + /api/auth/complete-profile with email TEST_iter15_<rand>@example.com / Test123!
seed_data_creation: ~15 transient TEST_ prefixed users created during this run via the progressive signup API. No cleanup fixture (matches prior iterations).
context_for_next_testing_agent: GET /api/hubs/regions returns {countries:[...]} with 13 entries (12 named African countries + 'other'); GET /api/hubs/cities returns {cities:[...]} with 100+ rows each carrying value/label/country/country_label/province. complete-profile accepts optional country/province/city and optional bank_name/account_number/swift_code/branch_number — when ALL four banking fields are present the backend persists user.banking with swift_code uppercased and a saved_at ISO timestamp. GET /api/users/me/banking returns {on_file:false} or {on_file:true, bank_name, account_last4, account_masked, swift_code, branch_number} — never the full account_number. POST /api/users/me/banking is auth-required and updates the same shape. /stokvels gates the intro using localStorage.nc_stokvel_intro_seen; /stokvels/intro is always-on. AuthPage step 2 has data-testids: signup-location-country / -province / -city, bank-name-input, account-number-input, swift-code-input, branch-number-input, plus the POPIA 'Encrypted & POPIA-protected' badge.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no critical/minor issues found in this iteration.
